name: Suwon and Hwaseong Fortress
tagline: An 18th-century fortress wall you can walk all the way round, gates, watchtowers and a palace, a short train ride south of Seoul.
highlight: Walking the fortress wall at sunset, with the gates and the city glowing below.
shortDescription: A UNESCO-listed fortress of about 5.7 km of walls, gates and turrets, with Haenggung Palace, archery, a traditional market and a famous fried chicken street, an easy day trip from Seoul.
metaDescription: A Suwon and Hwaseong Fortress travel guide: walking the wall, Paldalmun and Janganmun gates, Haenggung Palace, archery, Suwon fried chicken, how to get there from Seoul and a one-day plan.
knownFor: Fortress walls, gates, Haenggung Palace, UNESCO, fried chicken

image.alt: The stone walls and gate of Hwaseong Fortress in Suwon

intro: Hwaseong Fortress was built in the 1790s by King Jeongjo of the Joseon dynasty, who wanted a new city to honour his father and to strengthen the royal power. It took about two years to build, and was designed by scholars who studied Chinese and Western military engineering, with stone and brick walls, four main gates, watchtowers, bastions and a pavilion for signalling with fire. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and much of it has been restored using detailed records kept at the time.

The wall runs for about 5.7 km around the old part of Suwon, and it can be walked in two or three hours. The route passes gates such as Paldalmun in the south and Janganmun in the north, and offers views across the modern city. Inside the wall, Haenggung is a temporary palace where the king stayed on his visits, and there are archery ranges and a martial-arts performance.

Suwon lies about 30 km south of Seoul, so it is one of the easiest day trips from the capital, by subway or train in under an hour. It is also famous for its fried chicken and a lively market around the walls, and a day is enough for the wall, the palace and lunch.

whyVisit.intro: Hwaseong is the easiest historic day trip from Seoul, and a good place for a walk.
